note: DOCTRINE-NEGATIVE FIXTURE (prosperity family). The mustNotRank list is
the point: each entry is a classic prosperity proof-text pairing for this
query, and every forbidden verse is already IN the fixture corpus
precisely so this assertion can fail. A mustNotRank against an absent
verse passes vacuously — protection that is decoration. The verses are
Scripture and may rank honestly elsewhere; what is forbidden is the
query→verse pairing that frames them as a wealth technique. Criteria:
This is the query where the tithe-transaction pairing would look most
plausible — Malachi 3:10 really does say 'blessing' — which is exactly
why it is pinned: a searcher asking for financial blessing must not be
handed a giving-obligates-God mechanism as the answer.

mustNotRank.why: Tithe-transaction proof-text: 'bring the whole tithe … I will pour out a blessing' recruited as a return-on-giving mechanism (DOCTRINAL-BASIS.md §3). The verse ranks honestly for tithing queries.
'Give, and it will be given to you' recruited as an investment-return promise (DOCTRINAL-BASIS.md §3). It ranks honestly for giving queries, including the exact-phrase search of its own words.
'Whatever you ask believing, you will receive' recruited as a claim-it guarantee of financial return. DOCTRINAL-BASIS.md §3: God's power is not a technique.
'My God will supply every need of yours' — written to a church that had just given sacrificially to Paul's mission — recruited as an unconditional wealth guarantee (DOCTRINAL-BASIS.md §3).
